name: Hamuul Runetotem
statusNote: Changed in Forever. Requires level 10 instead of 12. From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
The shells you brought me have a taint, one I have never before seen.  I am certain the water of the Oases is the cause, and I can sense the confusion they cause this land.  It is as if the land dreams and cannot awake.

The Wailing Caverns must be the source of the taint.  But before you go there, speak with Hamuul Runetotem, the elder druid.  I sent word to him of the happenings in the Barrens.  He is wise, and can offer you counsel.

You will find him in Thunder Bluff, on the Elder Rise.
narrative.offerRewardText: I bid you greetings, adventurer. You are welcome here, and I suggest you gather all your strength. For the task we now set before you ... is a dire one.

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 10 to 22, 7,770 XP in all.

quests.name: The Barrens Oases
quests.objectiveText: Speak with Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.

quests.name: The Forgotten Pools
quests.objectiveText: Report back to Tonga Runetotem with your findings.

quests.name: The Stagnant Oasis
quests.objectiveText: Return to Tonga at The Crossroads, after investigating the Stagnant Oasis.

quests.name: Altered Beings
quests.objectiveText: Bring 8 Altered Snapjaw Shells to Tonga Runetotem at the Crossroads.

quests.name: Leaders of the Fang
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Gems of Cobrahn, Anacondra, Pythas and Serpentis to Nara Wildmane in Thunder Bluff.
